description: Read what is currently shown on the user's WidgetDash iPhone widgets: every enabled source with its metrics and last update time, or one source if source_key is given. Uses WIDGETDASH_READ_KEY, or the write key if no read key is set.

source_key.description: Only return this source. Omit to return all sources shown on the widget.

name: get_widget_data
title: Read iPhone widget data
